recognize_zh: 組織切片中成片的大型腫瘤細胞，細胞質豐富淡嗜酸性，多顆細胞核呈腎形或馬蹄形並有明顯核仁（hallmark cells），可見核分裂，是間變性大細胞淋巴瘤（ALCL）的典型形態。
features: Sheets of large cells with abundant pale eosinophilic to amphophilic cytoplasm and distinct cell borders
Eccentric kidney-shaped, horseshoe, and reniform nuclei (hallmark cells)
Vesicular chromatin with one or more prominent eosinophilic to basophilic nucleoli
Multilobated and pleomorphic nuclei with a mitotic figure present
Cohesive growth pattern that can mimic carcinoma; no well-defined background small lymphocytes in this field
describe_en: Tissue section shows sheets of large, cohesive-appearing neoplastic cells with abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and distinct cell borders. Nuclei are pleomorphic, with many eccentric horseshoe- or kidney-shaped forms (hallmark cells), vesicular chromatin, and prominent nucleoli; mitoses are present. The cohesive pattern may mimic carcinoma or melanoma. Findings are suggestive of anaplastic large cell lymphoma; confirmation with CD30, ALK, T-cell markers, EMA, and keratin immunostains is recommended.

ddx.vs: Carcinoma may look similarly cohesive but is keratin positive and CD30/ALK negative, and lacks horseshoe-shaped hallmark nuclei.
Hodgkin lymphoma has scattered Reed-Sternberg cells in a mixed inflammatory background rather than sheets of hallmark cells, and is PAX5 weakly positive and ALK negative.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, anaplastic variant
ddx.vs: Anaplastic DLBCL can be morphologically identical and is separated by expression of CD20 and PAX5 with ALK negativity.
Melanoma shows macronucleoli and may have pigment, and is SOX10 and S100 positive rather than CD30 and ALK positive.
